settings.title: Conhecimento para ir cada vez mais longe.

settings.editor: Do 3º ano do Ensino Fundamental à 3ª série do Ensino Médio, construímos uma trajetória de aprofundamento acadêmico, autonomia e formação integral — pensada para acompanhar cada fase do seu filho com propósito e excelência.

settings.html:
<style>
/* ==========================================================================
   Colégio Unicultura | Home - CSS da página (hero v2 + efeitos gerais)
   Vai embutido no widget HTML do bloco do hero. Classes: un-*, gt-root, gt-scrolled.
   ========================================================================== */

/* Parágrafos do Text Editor sem margem extra no último item */
.gt-root .elementor-widget-text-editor p:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}


/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   ANIMAÇÕES
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* Entradas mais suaves: as animações nativas do Elementor deslocam 100% da
   altura do elemento (ex.: 812px numa foto). Aqui o deslocamento é de 32px. */
.gt-root .animated {
  animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1);
}

.gt-root .fadeInUp {
  animation-name: gt-fade-in-up;
}

.gt-root .fadeInLeft {
  animation-name: gt-fade-in-left;
}

.gt-root .zoomIn {
  animation-name: gt-zoom-in;
}

@keyframes gt-fade-in-up {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(0, 32px, 0); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
}

@keyframes gt-fade-in-left {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(-32px, 0, 0); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
}

@keyframes gt-zoom-in {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.9); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
}



/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   HOVERS
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* Fotos: zoom suave no hover (Duas escolas) */
.un-zoom {
  overflow: hidden;
}

.un-zoom img {
  transition: transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1);
}

.un-zoom:hover img {
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

/* Movimento reduzido: o Elementor já desliga as entradas; aqui desligamos o resto */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .gt-top.gt-scrolled .gt-hero .gt-navbar,
  .gt-top.gt-scrolled .gt-navbar-logos {
    animation: none;
  }

  .un-zoom:hover img {
    transform: none;
  }
}


/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SCROLL E ANIMAÇÕES EXTRAS
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* Barra de progresso de leitura (criada pelo un-home.js) */
.un-progress {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  z-index: 10000;
  width: 100%;
  height: 3px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #F10505, #FF5A36);
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: 0 50%;
  pointer-events: none;
}

body.admin-bar .un-progress {
  top: 32px;
}

@media (max-width: 782px) {
  body.admin-bar .un-progress {
    top: 46px;
  }
}

/* Títulos das seções: "cortina" da esquerda para a direita ao entrar na tela */
.un-reveal.animated .elementor-heading-title {
  animation: un-reveal 1s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1) both;
}

@keyframes un-reveal {
  from { clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0); transform: translateX(-12px); }
  to   { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); transform: none; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .un-reveal.animated .elementor-heading-title {
    animation: none;
  }
}


/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   CABEÇALHO (fora do cartão)
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* Ponto vermelho sob o item ativo do menu (pointer do widget = nenhum) */
.un-header .elementor-nav-menu--main .elementor-item {
  position: relative;
}

.un-header .elementor-nav-menu--main .elementor-item.elementor-item-active::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: -2px;
  width: 5px;
  height: 5px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: #F10505;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
}

/* Logos brancos: só no cabeçalho flutuante (ao rolar) */
.un-header .un-logos--white {
  display: none;
}

/* Botões com seta em círculo vermelho (gira no hover) */
.un-btn-arrow .elementor-button-icon {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 30px;
  height: 30px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: #F10505;
  color: #FFFFFF;
  fill: #FFFFFF;
  font-size: 12px;
  transition: transform 0.4s ease;
}

.un-btn-arrow .elementor-button-icon svg {
  width: 1em;
  height: 1em;
  fill: currentColor;
}

.un-btn-arrow .elementor-button-icon i,
.un-btn-arrow .elementor-button-icon svg {
  transform: rotate(-45deg);
}

.un-btn-arrow .elementor-button:hover .elementor-button-icon {
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}

/* Link "Conhecer a proposta ↓": a seta desce no hover */
.un-btn-link .elementor-button-icon {
  transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

.un-btn-link .elementor-button:hover .elementor-button-icon {
  transform: translateY(3px);
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   CABEÇALHO FLUTUANTE ao rolar (desktop e tablet)
   O un-home.js adiciona .gt-scrolled ao .un-top depois de 40px de scroll.
   O .un-header-wrap guarda a altura do cabeçalho, então nada "pula".
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
@media (min-width: 768px) {
  body .un-top.gt-scrolled .un-header.un-header {
    position: fixed;
    top: 20px;
    left: 50%;
    z-index: 999;
    width: min(1240px, calc(100% - 48px));
    min-height: 68px;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    --padding-top: 8px;
    --padding-right: 10px;
    --padding-bottom: 8px;
    --padding-left: 28px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background-color: rgba(1, 6, 88, 0.94);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 34px rgba(1, 6, 88, 0.28);
    animation: un-header-in 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1) both;
  }

  body.admin-bar .un-top.gt-scrolled .un-header.un-header {
    top: 52px;
  }

  .un-top.gt-scrolled .un-header .un-logos--color {
    display: none;
  }

  .un-top.gt-scrolled .un-header .un-logos--white {
    display: flex;
  }

  body .un-top.gt-scrolled .un-header .elementor-nav-menu--main .elementor-item.elementor-item {
    color: #FFFFFF;
  }

  body .un-top.gt-scrolled .un-header .elementor-social-icon.elementor-social-icon {
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
  }

  body .un-top.gt-scrolled .un-header .elementor-social-icon i,
  body .un-top.gt-scrolled .un-header .elementor-social-icon svg {
    color: #FFFFFF;
    fill: #FFFFFF;
  }

  body .un-top.gt-scrolled .un-header .un-btn-arrow .elementor-button.elementor-button {
    background-color: #FFFFFF;
    color: #010658;
  }

  /* No editor: mostra o espaço dos logos brancos (tracejado) para trocar as imagens */
  .elementor-editor-active .un-header .un-logos--white {
    display: flex;
    outline: 1px dashed rgba(1, 6, 88, 0.4);
    outline-offset: 4px;
  }
}

@media (min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 782px) {
  body.admin-bar .un-top.gt-scrolled .un-header.un-header {
    top: 66px;
  }
}

@keyframes un-header-in {
  from { opacity: 0.6; width: 1000px; transform: translate(-50%, -8px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; width: min(1240px, calc(100% - 48px)); transform: translate(-50%, 0); }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   CARTÃO DO HERO
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* Selo e segmentos: pontinhos vermelhos */
.un-hero .un-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  margin-right: 10px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: #F10505;
  vertical-align: middle;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(241, 5, 5, 0.18);
}

/* Segmentos: o 1º item não tem o ponto separador */
.un-hero .un-segments .elementor-icon-list-item:first-child .elementor-icon-list-icon {
  display: none;
}

/* Celular: foto no topo do cartão, dissolvendo no azul (slideshow nativo) */
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .un-top .un-hero .elementor-background-slideshow .elementor-background-slideshow__slide__image {
    background-size: 230% auto;
    background-position: 88% 0;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    background-color: #0D1261;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .un-top.gt-scrolled .un-header {
    animation: none;
  }
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Colégio Unicultura | Ensino Fundamental I - efeitos da página
   Vai embutido (junto com un-home-v2.css) no widget HTML do topo.
   O un-fund1.js adiciona .un-js ao <html> e .is-in aos elementos .un-io
   quando eles entram na tela. Sem JS (ou no editor), tudo aparece normalmente.
   ========================================================================== */

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   HERO
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* Cartão "abre" ao carregar a página */
.un-top .un-hero {
  animation: un-card-in 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1) both;
}

@keyframes un-card-in {
  from { clip-path: inset(4% 2% round 40px); opacity: 0.4; }
  to   { clip-path: inset(0 round 40px); opacity: 1; }
}

/* Ao rolar, o texto do hero sobe mais devagar e esmaece (--un-out: 0 a 1, via JS) */
@media (min-width: 1025px) {
  .un-top .un-hero .un-hero-content {
    transform: translate3d(0, calc(var(--un-out, 0) * -70px), 0);
    opacity: calc(1 - var(--un-out, 0) * 0.7);
  }
}

/* Avatares sobrepostos na prova social */
.un-hero .un-avatars > .elementor-widget-image + .elementor-widget-image {
  margin-left: -12px;
}

/* Segmentos: o item da página atual fica destacado (--2 Fund. I, --3 Fund. II, --4 Ensino Médio) */
.un-hero .un-segments--2 .elementor-icon-list-item:nth-child(2) .elementor-icon-list-text,
.un-hero .un-segments--3 .elementor-icon-list-item:nth-child(3) .elementor-icon-list-text,
.un-hero .un-segments--4 .elementor-icon-list-item:nth-child(4) .elementor-icon-list-text {
  color: #FFB867;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   UMA ETAPA DE TRANSIÇÃO
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

.un-etapa .un-etapa-media {
  position: relative;
}

/* Foto: "cortina" de baixo para cima + zoom saindo */
.un-etapa .un-clip {
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 32px;
}

.un-etapa .un-clip.animated img {
  animation: un-clip 1.4s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1) both;
}

@keyframes un-clip {
  from { clip-path: inset(100% 0 0 0); transform: scale(1.18); }
  to   { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); transform: none; }
}

/* Selo flutuante sobre a foto */
body .un-etapa .un-badge.e-con {
  position: absolute;
  right: -28px;
  bottom: 40px;
  width: max-content;
  z-index: 2;
  transition: opacity 0.7s ease 0.6s, transform 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1) 0.6s;
}

.un-js .un-etapa .un-io:not(.is-in) .un-badge {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translate3d(0, 24px, 0) scale(0.92);
}

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  body .un-etapa .un-badge.e-con {
    right: 20px;
    bottom: -24px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .un-etapa .un-clip {
    border-radius: 24px;
  }

  body .un-etapa .un-badge.e-con {
    right: 14px;
  }
}

/* Frase de destaque: marca-texto passa por "crescem juntos." ao aparecer */
.un-quote .un-mark {
  color: #F10505;
  background: linear-gradient(transparent 60%, rgba(241, 5, 5, 0.14) 60%) no-repeat 0 0 / 100% 100%;
  transition: background-size 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1) 0.5s;
}

.un-js .un-quote:not(.is-in) .un-mark {
  background-size: 0% 100%;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   O QUE PRIORIZAMOS
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* Título fica fixo enquanto os cards passam (desktop) */
@media (min-width: 1025px) {
  body .un-prioridades .un-sticky.e-con {
    position: sticky;
    top: 130px;
  }
}

/* "nessa etapa:" em pílula azul, que "carimba" ao aparecer */
.un-prioridades .un-pill {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 0 18px 4px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background-color: #010658;
  color: #FFFFFF;
  transform: rotate(-2deg);
  transition: transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) 0.4s, opacity 0.5s ease 0.4s;
}

.un-js .un-prioridades .un-io:not(.is-in) .un-pill {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: rotate(-8deg) scale(0.7);
}

/* Cards: sobem no hover, ícone gira de leve, linha vermelha cresce embaixo */
.un-prioridades .un-prio {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 0.45s ease, border-color 0.45s ease;
}

.un-prioridades .un-prio::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 3px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #F10505, #FF5A36);
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: 0 50%;
  transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1);
}

.un-prioridades .un-prio .elementor-icon {
  transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
}

@media (hover: hover) {
  .un-prioridades .un-prio:hover {
    transform: translateY(-6px);
    border-color: rgba(1, 6, 88, 0) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(1, 6, 88, 0.12);
  }

  .un-prioridades .un-prio:hover::after {
    transform: scaleX(1);
  }

  .un-prioridades .un-prio:hover .elementor-icon {
    transform: rotate(-8deg) scale(1.08);
  }
}

.un-prioridades .un-prio .elementor-icon-box-title {
  margin: 0;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SISTEMA DE ENSINO (Poliedro)
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* Logo flutuando devagar */
.un-poliedro .un-float img {
  animation: un-bob 6s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes un-bob {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
  50%      { transform: translateY(-10px); }
}

/* Anel pulsando atrás do logo */
.un-poliedro .un-poliedro-logo {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.un-poliedro .un-poliedro-logo::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  width: 260px;
  height: 260px;
  margin: -130px 0 0 -130px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(1, 6, 88, 0.1);
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: un-ring 4s ease-out infinite;
  pointer-events: none;
}

@keyframes un-ring {
  from { transform: scale(0.6); opacity: 1; }
  to   { transform: scale(1.6); opacity: 0; }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   EQUIPE
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

.un-equipe .un-it {
  color: #F10505;
  font-style: italic;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.un-equipe .un-teacher {
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 0.45s ease;
}

.un-equipe .un-teacher-photo {
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 28px 28px 0 0;
}

.un-equipe .un-teacher-photo img {
  transition: transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1);
}

@media (hover: hover) {
  .un-equipe .un-teacher:hover {
    transform: translateY(-6px);
    box-shadow: 0 20px 44px rgba(1, 6, 88, 0.12) !important;
  }

  .un-equipe .un-teacher:hover .un-teacher-photo img {
    transform: scale(1.05);
  }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   CTA COM FORMULÁRIO
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

.un-cta .un-cta-photo {
  overflow: hidden;
}

.un-cta .un-cta-photo img {
  transition: transform 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1);
}

.un-cta .e-con:hover > .un-cta-photo img {
  transform: scale(1.04);
}

/* Campos: brilho suave ao focar */
.un-cta .un-form .elementor-field-textual {
  transition: box-shadow 0.3s ease, background-color 0.3s ease;
}

.un-cta .un-form .elementor-field-textual:focus {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 184, 103, 0.55);
}

.un-cta .un-form .elementor-button {
  transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
}

.un-cta .un-form .elementor-button:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   MOVIMENTO REDUZIDO
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .un-top .un-hero,
  .un-etapa .un-clip.animated img,
  .un-poliedro .un-float img,
  .un-poliedro .un-poliedro-logo::before {
    animation: none;
  }

  .un-top .un-hero .un-hero-content {
    transform: none;
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Colégio Unicultura | Ensino Fundamental II - efeitos próprios desta página
   Vai embutido no widget HTML do topo, depois de un-home-v2.css e un-fund1.css
   (que já trazem cabeçalho, hero, .un-io/.is-in, galeria, Poliedro, equipe e CTA).
   ========================================================================== */

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   FAIXA EM MOVIMENTO (palavras-chave)
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* Faixa azul levemente inclinada, mais larga que a tela para as pontas não aparecerem */
.un-mq .un-mq-band {
  width: calc(100% + 80px);
  margin-left: -40px;
  transform: rotate(-2deg);
}

.un-mq .un-mq-track {
  animation: un-mq-left 38s linear infinite;
}

.un-mq .un-mq-band:hover .un-mq-track {
  animation-play-state: paused;
}

.un-mq .un-mq-text .elementor-heading-title {
  white-space: nowrap;
  padding-right: 0.6em;
}

.un-mq .un-star {
  display: inline-block;
  margin: 0 0.6em;
  color: #FFB867;
  font-size: 0.6em;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

@keyframes un-mq-left {
  from { transform: translateX(0); }
  to   { transform: translateX(-50%); }
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .un-mq .un-mq-track {
    animation-duration: 26s;
  }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   TRÊS EIXOS: foto fixa + linha do tempo que se preenche com o scroll
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

@media (min-width: 1025px) {
  body .un-eixos .un-sticky.e-con {
    position: sticky;
    top: 130px;
  }
}

.un-eixos .un-eixos-photo img {
  animation: un-bob 7s ease-in-out infinite;
}

/* Linha vertical (trilho cinza + preenchimento vermelho, --un-fill de 0 a 1 via JS) */
.un-eixos .un-timeline {
  position: relative;
}

.un-eixos .un-timeline::before,
.un-eixos .un-timeline::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 8px;
  bottom: 8px;
  left: 13px;
  width: 2px;
  height: auto; /* o Elementor força 100% no ::before dos containers */
  border-radius: 2px;
  background-color: rgba(1, 6, 88, 0.1);
}

.un-eixos .un-timeline::after {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #F10505, #FF5A36);
  transform: scaleY(var(--un-fill, 1));
  transform-origin: 50% 0;
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .un-eixos .un-timeline::before,
  .un-eixos .un-timeline::after {
    left: 8px;
  }
}

/* Cards: ponto na linha + entrada quando chegam na tela */
.un-eixos .un-eixo {
  position: relative;
  transition: opacity 0.7s ease, transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 0.45s ease;
}

.un-eixos .un-eixo::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 30px;
  left: -38px;
  z-index: 1;
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  border: 3px solid #FDFDFF;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: #F10505;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(241, 5, 5, 0.18);
  transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) 0.2s;
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .un-eixos .un-eixo::before {
    left: -28px;
    width: 12px;
    height: 12px;
  }
}

.un-js .un-eixos .un-eixo:not(.is-in) {
  opacity: 0.2;
  transform: translate3d(28px, 0, 0);
}

.un-js .un-eixos .un-eixo:not(.is-in)::before {
  transform: scale(0);
}

@media (hover: hover) {
  .un-eixos .un-eixo:hover {
    box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(1, 6, 88, 0.22);
  }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   APROFUNDAR, ARGUMENTAR E INVESTIGAR: as palavras entram uma a uma
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

.un-words .un-word {
  display: inline-block;
  transition: opacity 0.6s ease, transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), filter 0.8s ease;
}

.un-words .un-word:nth-child(2) {
  transition-delay: 0.18s;
}

.un-words .un-word:nth-child(3) {
  transition-delay: 0.36s;
}

.un-js .un-words:not(.is-in) .un-word {
  opacity: 0;
  filter: blur(8px);
  transform: translate3d(0, 0.4em, 0);
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   APOIO QUE ACOMPANHA DE PERTO
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

.un-apoio .un-apoio-logo {
  position: relative;
}

/* Anéis pulsando atrás do logo */
.un-apoio .un-apoio-logo::before,

/* ==========================================================================
   Colégio Unicultura | Diferenciais - efeitos da página
   Vai embutido no widget HTML do topo, depois de un-home-v2.css e un-fund1.css
   (cabeçalho flutuante, botões com seta, entradas suaves, .un-io/.is-in, anéis).
   ========================================================================== */

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   HERO: brilho no cartão + órbita dos 8 diferenciais
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

.un-hero--dif {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.un-hero--dif::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -20%;
  right: -10%;
  z-index: -1;
  width: 60%;
  height: auto; /* o Elementor força 100% no ::before dos containers */
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(241, 5, 5, 0.28), rgba(255, 184, 103, 0.08) 45%, transparent 70%);
  animation: un-glow 14s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.un-hero--dif::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) 1.2px, transparent 1.2px);
  background-size: 24px 24px;
  -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(250deg, #000 5%, transparent 55%);
  mask-image: linear-gradient(250deg, #000 5%, transparent 55%);
  pointer-events: none;
}

@keyframes un-glow {
  from { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }
  to   { transform: translate(-15%, 20%) scale(1.15); }
}

.un-orbit {
  --size: 460px;
  position: relative;
  width: var(--size);
  height: var(--size);
  max-width: 100%;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.un-orbit-core {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 148px;
  height: 148px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #F10505;
  color: #FFFFFF;
  font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 14px rgba(241, 5, 5, 0.14), 0 0 0 30px rgba(241, 5, 5, 0.06);
}

.un-orbit-core strong {
  font-size: 56px;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
}

.un-orbit-core span {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.un-orbit-ring {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  border: 1px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: un-spin 60s linear infinite;
}

.un-orbit-ring--1 {
  --r: 138px;
  width: 276px;
  height: 276px;
  margin: -138px 0 0 -138px;
}

.un-orbit-ring--2 {
  --r: 222px;
  width: 444px;
  height: 444px;
  margin: -222px 0 0 -222px;
  animation-direction: reverse;
  animation-duration: 80s;
}

.un-orbit-item {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  width: 0;
  height: 0;
  transform: rotate(var(--a)) translate(var(--r)) rotate(calc(-1 * var(--a)));
}

/* A bolha gira ao contrário do anel, para o ícone ficar sempre em pé */
.un-orbit-bubble {
  position: absolute;
  top: -29px;
  left: -29px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 58px;
  height: 58px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #FFFFFF;
  color: #010658;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
  animation: un-spin 60s linear infinite reverse;
  transition: background-color 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
}

.un-orbit-ring--2 .un-orbit-bubble {
  animation-direction: normal;
  animation-duration: 80s;
}

.un-orbit-bubble svg {
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
}

.un-orbit-label {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(100% + 8px);
  left: 50%;
  padding: 5px 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #FFB867;
  color: #010658;
  font: 700 12px/1.2 "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif;
  white-space: nowrap;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translate(-50%, -4px);
  transition: opacity 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.un-orbit:hover .un-orbit-ring,
.un-orbit:hover .un-orbit-bubble {
  animation-play-state: paused;
}

.un-orbit-item:hover .un-orbit-bubble,
.un-orbit-item:focus-visible .un-orbit-bubble {
  background: #F10505;
  color: #FFFFFF;
}

.un-orbit-item:hover .un-orbit-label,
.un-orbit-item:focus-visible .un-orbit-label {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translate(-50%, 0);
}

@keyframes un-spin {
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .un-orbit {
    transform: scale(0.85);
    margin: -30px auto;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .un-orbit {
    transform: scale(0.62);
    margin: -80px auto -70px;
  }
}

/* Índice do hero: primeiro item sem o ponto separador */
.un-hero-nav .elementor-icon-list-item:first-child .elementor-icon-list-icon {
  display: none;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   CAPÍTULOS: número gigante vazado ao fundo
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

.un-chapter > .e-con-inner {
  position: relative;
}

body .un-chapter .un-bignum.elementor-widget {
  position: absolute;
  top: -70px;
  right: -10px;
  z-index: 0;
  width: auto;
  margin: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.un-chapter .un-bignum .elementor-heading-title {
  color: transparent;
  -webkit-text-stroke: 2px rgba(1, 6, 88, 0.08);
}

.un-chapter .un-bignum--dark .elementor-heading-title {
  -webkit-text-stroke-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

.un-chapter > .e-con-inner > .e-con,
.un-chapter > .e-con-inner > .elementor-element:not(.un-bignum) {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {
  body .un-chapter .un-bignum.elementor-widget {
    top: -40px;
    right: -6px;
  }
}

/* Marca-texto que passa por trás da palavra quando o título entra na tela */
.un-chapter .un-mark {
  background: linear-gradient(transparent 62%, rgba(241, 5, 5, 0.18) 62%) no-repeat 0 0 / 100% 100%;
  transition: background-size 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1) 0.4s;
}

.un-js .un-chapter .un-io:not(.is-in) .un-mark,
.un-js .un-chapter .un-io.un-banner:not(.is-in) .un-mark {
  background-size: 0% 100%;
}

/* Fotos: "cortina" de baixo para cima */
.un-chapter .un-clip {
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 28px;
}

.un-chapter .un-clip.animated img {
  animation: un-clip 1.4s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1) both;
}

@keyframes un-clip {
  from { clip-path: inset(100% 0 0 0); transform: scale(1.15); }
  to   { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); transform: none; }
}

/* Pílulas de palavras-chave */
.un-pills .elementor-icon-list-icon {
  display: none;
}

.un-pills .elementor-icon-list-item {
  padding: 9px 16px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(1, 6, 88, 0.12);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background-color: #FFFFFF;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease, background-color 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease;
}

.un-pills--dark .elementor-icon-list-item {
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
}

@media (hover: hover) {
  .un-pills .elementor-icon-list-item:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    background-color: #010658;
  }

  .un-pills .elementor-icon-list-item:hover .elementor-icon-list-text {
    color: #FFFFFF;
  }

  .un-pills--dark .elementor-icon-list-item:hover {
    background-color: #F10505;
  }
}

/* Checks em círculos */
.un-checks .elementor-icon-list-icon {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: rgba(241, 5, 5, 0.1);
}

/* Cards: sobem no hover e o ícone gira */
.un-chapter .un-card {
  transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 0.45s ease, border-color 0.45s ease;
}

.un-chapter .un-card-icon .elementor-icon {
  transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), background-color 0.4s ease, color 0.4s ease;
}

@media (hover: hover) {
  .un-chapter .un-card:not(.un-tilt):hover {
    transform: translateY(-6px);
    box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(1, 6, 88, 0.12);
  }

  .un-chapter .un-card:hover .un-card-icon .elementor-icon {
    transform: rotate(-10deg) scale(1.08);
  }
}

/* Foto + selo flutuante */
.un-chapter .un-media {
  position: relative;
}

body .un-chapter .un-float-badge.e-con {
  position: absolute;
  left: -24px;
  bottom: 36px;
  z-index: 2;
  transition: opacity 0.7s ease 0.5s, transform 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1) 0.5s;
}

.un-js .un-chapter .un-io:not(.is-in) .un-float-badge {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translate3d(0, 24px, 0) scale(0.92);
}

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  body .un-chapter .un-float-badge.e-con {
    left: 16px;
    bottom: -24px;
  }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   01 OLIMPÍADAS: medalha balançando
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

.un-medal-card {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.un-medal-card::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 18%;
  left: 50%;
  width: 360px;
  height: 360px;
  margin-left: -180px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 184, 103, 0.25), transparent 65%);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.un-medal {
  display: block;
  width: 180px;
  height: auto;
  margin: 0 auto;
  transform-origin: 50% 0;
  animation: un-swing 4.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.un-medal-shine {
  animation: un-twinkle 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes un-swing {
  0%, 100% { transform: rotate(5deg); }
  50%      { transform: rotate(-5deg); }
}

@keyframes un-twinkle {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.15; }
  50%      { opacity: 0.6; }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   03 CLUBE DE LEITURA: palavras vazadas que se preenchem
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

.un-words-list .un-fill-word .elementor-heading-title {
  color: #010658;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #F10505, #F10505) no-repeat 0 100% / 0 3px;
  transition: color 0.8s ease, -webkit-text-stroke-color 0.8s ease, background-size 0.9s ease 0.2s;
}

.un-js .un-words-list .un-fill-word:not(.is-in) .elementor-heading-title {
  color: transparent;
  -webkit-text-stroke: 1.5px rgba(1, 6, 88, 0.35);
}

.un-words-list .un-fill-word.is-in:last-child .elementor-heading-title {
  color: #F10505;
}

@media (hover: hover) {
  .un-words-list .un-fill-word .elementor-heading-title:hover {
    background-size: 100% 3px;
  }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   04 PENSAMENTO COMPUTACIONAL: grade + terminal + cards com inclinação 3D
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

.un-grid-bg {
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.045) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.045) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 48px 48px;
}

.un-term {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  color: #FFB867;
  font: 600 15px/1.2 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
}

.un-term-prompt {
  color: #F10505;
}

.un-term-text {
  display: inline-block;
  overflow: hidden;
  white-space: nowrap;
  width: 23ch;
  animation: un-type 2.6s steps(23) 0.6s both;
}

.un-term-caret {
  width: 9px;
  height: 18px;
  background: #FFB867;
  animation: un-blink 1s steps(1) infinite;
}

@keyframes un-type {
  from { width: 0; }
  to   { width: 23ch; }
}

@keyframes un-blink {
  50% { opacity: 0; }
}

.un-chapter .un-tilt {
  transform-style: preserve-3d;
  will-change: transform;
}

@media (hover: hover) {
  .un-chapter .un-tilt:hover {
    border-color: rgba(255, 184, 103, 0.5);
    box-shadow: 0 24px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
  }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   06 BILÍNGUE: balões flutuando sobre a foto
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

body .un-chapter .un-bubbles-wrap.elementor-widget {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  margin: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.un-bubble {
  position: absolute;
  padding: 14px 22px;
  border-radius: 22px;
  font: 800 26px/1 "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif;
  box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(1, 6, 88, 0.2);
  animation: un-bob 5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.un-bubble--en {
  top: 28px;
  left: -22px;
  border-bottom-left-radius: 4px;
  background: #F10505;
  color: #FFFFFF;
}

.un-bubble--pt {
  right: -18px;
  bottom: 44px;
  border-bottom-right-radius: 4px;
  background: #FFFFFF;
  color: #010658;
  animation-delay: -2.5s;
}

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .un-bubble--en { left: 14px; }
  .un-bubble--pt { right: 14px; }
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .un-bubble {
    padding: 10px 16px;
    font-size: 20px;
  }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   CTA FINAL
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

.un-cta-card {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.un-cta-card::before,
.un-cta-card::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  z-index: -1;
  width: 520px;
  height: 520px;
  margin: -260px 0 0 -260px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: un-ring 6s ease-out infinite;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.un-cta-card::after {
  animation-delay: 3s;
}

.un-btn-whats .elementor-button {
  transition: background-color 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease;
}

.un-btn-whats .elementor-button:hover {
  background-color: #25D366 !important;
  border-color: #25D366 !important;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   ÍNDICE LATERAL FIXO (criado pelo un-dif.js) - só em telas grandes
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

.un-chapnav {
  position: fixed;
  top: 50%;
  right: 22px;
  z-index: 998;
  display: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 12px 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(1, 6, 88, 0.14);
  list-style: none;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translate(20px, -50%);
  transition: opacity 0.4s ease, transform 0.4s ease;
}

.un-chapnav.is-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translate(0, -50%);
}

@media (min-width: 1200px) {
  .un-chapnav {
    display: block;
  }
}

.un-chapnav li {
  margin: 0;
}

.un-chapnav a {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.un-chapnav a::before {
  content: "";
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(1, 6, 88, 0.25);
  transition: transform 0.3s ease, background-color 0.3s ease;
}

.un-chapnav a.is-active::before {
  background: #F10505;
  transform: scale(1.5);
}

.un-chapnav span {
  position: absolute;
  right: calc(100% + 10px);
  padding: 5px 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #010658;
  color: #FFFFFF;
  font: 700 12px/1.2 "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif;
  white-space: nowrap;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateX(6px);
  transition: opacity 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.un-chapnav a:hover span,
.un-chapnav a.is-active span {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   MOVIMENTO REDUZIDO
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .un-hero--dif::before,
  .un-orbit-ring,
  .un-orbit-bubble,
  .un-medal,
  .un-medal-shine,
  .un-term-text,
  .un-term-caret,
  .un-bubble,
  .un-cta-card::before,
  .un-cta-card::after,
  .un-chapter .un-clip.animated img {
    animation: none;
  }
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Colégio Unicultura | Sobre - efeitos da página
   Vai embutido no widget HTML do topo, depois de un-home-v2, un-fund1, un-fund2 e un-dif
   (cabeçalho, hero, .un-io/.is-in, faixa de palavras, cards, galeria, Poliedro, CTA).

/* Destaque do título: marca-texto vermelho suave, texto branco (sem amarelo) */

  background: linear-gradient(transparent 60%, rgba(241, 5, 5, 0.32) 60%) no-repeat 0 0 / 100% 100%;
}

/* Faixa de palavras: estrelas em vermelho claro */
.un-mq .un-star {
  color: #FF8A8A;
}

   TRAJETÓRIA: colagem de fotos

.un-trajetoria .un-clip.animated img {

/* Foto menor sobreposta no canto, com borda branca */

  left: -22px;
  z-index: 2;
  box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(1, 6, 88, 0.25);

.un-js .un-trajetoria .un-collage:not(.is-in) .un-collage-badge {

@media (max-width: 1024px) {

  body .un-trajetoria .un-collage-badge.e-con {

/* Chamada para a Garatuja */

@media (hover: hover) {

    border-color: rgba(241, 5, 5, 0.3) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(1, 6, 88, 0.1);

}

.un-garatuja-link a {
  color: inherit;

<script>
/* Colégio Unicultura | Home - comportamentos da página (CSS em un-home-v2.css).
   Nenhum deles roda dentro do editor do Elementor. */
(function () {
  if (document.body.classList.contains('elementor-editor-active')) {
    return;
  }
  var reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  /* 1. Cabeçalho flutuante: adiciona .gt-scrolled ao .un-top após 40px de scroll */
  var tops = document.querySelectorAll('.un-top');

  /* 2. Barra de progresso de leitura (vermelha, no topo da tela) */
  var bar = document.createElement('div');
  bar.className = 'un-progress';
  bar.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  document.body.appendChild(bar);

  var ticking = false;
  function onScroll() {
    ticking = false;
    var y = window.scrollY;
    tops.forEach(function (el) {
      el.classList.toggle('gt-scrolled', y > 40);
    });
    var max = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
    bar.style.transform = 'scaleX(' + (max > 0 ? Math.min(1, y / max) : 0) + ')';
  }
  function requestScroll() {
    if (!ticking) {
      ticking = true;
      window.requestAnimationFrame(onScroll);
    }
  }
  onScroll();
  window.addEventListener('scroll', requestScroll, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('resize', requestScroll);

  /* 3. Contador: o primeiro número do título com a classe .un-count (ex.: "+1.200 famílias")
        conta de 0 até o valor quando aparece. data-delay (ms) espera outra animação terminar. */
  function countUp(title) {
    // primeiro trecho de texto com número (pode estar dentro de <strong>, <span>...)
    var walker = document.createTreeWalker(title, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
    var node = null;
    var match = null;
    while (walker.nextNode()) {
      match = walker.currentNode.nodeValue.match(/([\d.]+)/);
      if (match) {
        node = walker.currentNode;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (!node) {
      return;
    }
    var target = parseInt(match[1].replace(/\./g, ''), 10);
    var before = node.nodeValue.slice(0, match.index);
    var after = node.nodeValue.slice(match.index + match[1].length);
    var duration = 1600;
    var start = null;
    function frame(now) {
      if (start === null) {
        start = now;
      }
      var t = Math.min(1, (now - start) / duration);
      var eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
      node.nodeValue = before + Math.round(target * eased).toLocaleString('pt-BR') + after;
      if (t < 1) {
        window.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      }
    }
    node.nodeValue = before + '0' + after;
    window.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  if (!reduceMotion && 'IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.un-count').forEach(function (widget) {
      var title = widget.querySelector('.elementor-heading-title');
      if (!title) {
        return;
      }
      var delay = parseInt(widget.getAttribute('data-delay') || '0', 10);
      var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        if (entries[0].isIntersecting) {
          observer.disconnect();
          window.setTimeout(function () {
            countUp(title);
          }, delay);
        }
      }, { threshold: 0.6 });
      observer.observe(widget);
    });
  }
})();

/* Colégio Unicultura | Ensino Fundamental I - efeitos de scroll (CSS em un-fund1.css).
   Não roda no editor do Elementor; com "reduzir movimento", tudo aparece direto. */
(function () {
  if (document.body.classList.contains('elementor-editor-active')) {
    return;
  }
  var reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  if (reduceMotion || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
    return;
  }
  document.documentElement.classList.add('un-js');

  /* 1. .un-io ganha .is-in quando entra na tela (selo da foto, marca-texto, pílula).
        Este script fica no topo da página: espera o resto do HTML carregar. */
  function watch() {
    var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (entry) {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('is-in');
          observer.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.35 });
    document.querySelectorAll('.un-io').forEach(function (el) {
      observer.observe(el);
    });
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', watch);
  } else {
    watch();
  }

  /* 2. Hero: --un-out vai de 0 a 1 enquanto o cartão sai da tela (o CSS usa só no desktop) */
  var hero = document.querySelector('.un-top .un-hero');
  if (!hero) {
    return;
  }
  var ticking = false;
  function update() {
    ticking = false;
    var height = hero.offsetHeight || 1;
    var out = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, window.scrollY / height));
    hero.style.setProperty('--un-out', out.toFixed(3));
  }
  window.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
    if (!ticking) {
      ticking = true;
      window.requestAnimationFrame(update);
    }
  }, { passive: true });
  update();
})();
</script>

<style>
/* ==========================================================================
   Colégio Unicultura | Home - Seção "Galeria" (vai embutido no JSON dela)
   Uma faixa de fotos verticais (proporção 480x652) em "degraus", em movimento
   contínuo, que também desliza com o scroll (un-galeria.js). Hover: faixa pausa,
   foto em foco.
   Escopo: .un-gal
   ========================================================================== */

.un-gal {
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Fileira: recebe o deslocamento do scroll (--un-gal-shift, via JS) */
.un-gal .un-gal-row {
  transform: translate3d(var(--un-gal-shift, 0px), 0, 0);
  will-change: transform;
  -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 8%, #000 92%, transparent);
  mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 8%, #000 92%, transparent);
}

/* Trilho: movimento contínuo. Contém o conjunto original + uma cópia. */
.un-gal .un-gal-track {
  width: max-content;
  /* começa 140px antes da borda: o deslocamento do scroll (até 120px) nunca mostra vão */
  margin-left: -140px;
  animation: un-gal-left 70s linear infinite;
}

.un-gal .un-gal-row--right .un-gal-track {
  animation-duration: 80s;
  animation-direction: reverse;
}

.un-gal .un-gal-row:hover .un-gal-track {
  animation-play-state: paused;
}

@keyframes un-gal-left {
  from { transform: translateX(0); }
  to   { transform: translateX(-50%); }
}

/* Conjunto: padding igual ao gap, para a emenda da cópia ficar invisível */
.un-gal .un-gal-set {
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
}

/* "Degraus": fotos pares um pouco mais baixas (ritmo sem cortar as fotos verticais) */
.un-gal .un-gal-set > .un-gal-photo:nth-child(even) {
  margin-top: 56px;
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .un-gal .un-gal-set > .un-gal-photo:nth-child(even) {
    margin-top: 28px;
  }
}

/* Foto */
.un-gal .un-gal-photo {
  position: relative;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 24px;
  transition: opacity 0.4s ease, transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1);
}

.un-gal .un-gal-photo img {
  display: block;
  transition: transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1);
}

/* Foco: as outras fotos da fileira escurecem, a do mouse cresce */
.un-gal .un-gal-row:hover .un-gal-photo {
  opacity: 0.55;
}

.un-gal .un-gal-row:hover .un-gal-photo:hover {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: scale(1.03);
  z-index: 2;
}

.un-gal .un-gal-photo:hover img {
  transform: scale(1.06);
}

/* "+" vermelho: indica que abre em tela cheia */
.un-gal .un-gal-photo::after {
  content: "+";
  position: absolute;
  right: 14px;
  bottom: 14px;
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: #F10505;
  color: #FFFFFF;
  font: 400 26px/38px "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif;
  text-align: center;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: scale(0.6);
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.un-gal .un-gal-photo:hover::after {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: scale(1);
}

/* Celular: fotos menores, sem foco de hover (toque abre o lightbox) */
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .un-gal .un-gal-track {
    animation-duration: 50s;
  }

  .un-gal .un-gal-row--right .un-gal-track {
    animation-duration: 58s;
  }
}

/* Movimento reduzido: fileiras paradas e sem deslocamento de scroll */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .un-gal .un-gal-track {
    animation: none;
  }

  .un-gal .un-gal-row {
    transform: none;
    overflow-x: auto;
  }
}
</style>
<script>
/* Unicultura | Seção Galeria - as fileiras deslizam em sentidos opostos com o scroll.
   Escreve --un-gal-shift em cada .un-gal-row (o CSS aplica o translate).
   Não roda no editor do Elementor nem com "reduzir movimento". */
(function () {
  if (document.body.classList.contains('elementor-editor-active')) {
    return;
  }
  if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
    return;
  }
  var sections = document.querySelectorAll('.un-gal');
  if (!sections.length) {
    return;
  }
  var ticking = false;

  function update() {
    ticking = false;
    var vh = window.innerHeight;
    sections.forEach(function (section) {
      var rect = section.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (rect.bottom < 0 || rect.top > vh) {
        return;
      }
      // -1 quando a seção entra por baixo, +1 quando sai por cima
      var progress = ((vh - rect.top) / (vh + rect.height)) * 2 - 1;
      var amount = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, progress)) * 120;
      section.querySelectorAll('.un-gal-row').forEach(function (row) {
        var dir = row.classList.contains('un-gal-row--right') ? 1 : -1;
        row.style.setProperty('--un-gal-shift', (amount * dir).toFixed(1) + 'px');
      });
    });
  }

  function requestUpdate() {
    if (!ticking) {
      ticking = true;
      window.requestAnimationFrame(update);
    }
  }

  update();
  window.addEventListener('scroll', requestUpdate, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('resize', requestUpdate);
})();
</script>
